what: Vale is one of the world's largest iron ore producers, mining in Brazil and shipping mostly to Chinese steelmakers. It also produces nickel and copper, and is one of the largest nickel producers outside Russia.
customers: Chinese and other Asian steelmakers, plus battery, stainless steel and electrical customers for nickel and copper.
money: iron ore and pellets from Brazilian mines
nickel and copper from Canada, Brazil and Indonesia
moat: Some of the highest-grade iron ore in the world, which steelmakers pay a premium for because it produces less waste and emissions.
risks: Chinese steel demand drives the iron ore price and therefore its earnings
Liabilities from the Brumadinho and Mariana dam disasters continue to cost money
Brazilian politics affect it as a nationally significant company
Net margin fell to about 6% after charges
opportunities: A dividend yield above 8% when iron ore prices hold up
Analysts see large upside, with a median target well above the current price
Copper and nickel expansion diversifies it away from iron ore
watch: Iron ore shipment volumes and the realised price per tonne.
